blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—National University entered the win column after easing past University of the East, 76-56, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The Bulldogs recovered from an opening day loss at the hands of defending champion La Salle to improve to a 1-1 card. “In our first game, I don’t know why, but we had a lot of lapses that we needed to work on,” NU coach Jeff Napa, whose team led by as many as 23, said in Filipino.
